title: Geometric simple orbit decomposition with local point transports
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field and $l$ an invertible prime. Let $X/k_0$ be smooth affine of finite type, and let $V$ be a nonzero irreducible lisse sheaf in the source pro-etale Weil category [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Let $x,y$ be closed points where its stalks are nonzero. There exist a finite extension $k_1/k_0$, a smooth geometrically connected separated affine finite-type $C/k_1$ of constant dimension $d>0$, a morphism $c:C\to X$ over the field extension, an exact functor $R$ from source Weil sheaves on $X/k_0$ to those on $C/k_1$, and finitely many geometrically irreducible $S_a$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] with $R(V)\simeq\bigoplus_a S_a$. The functor preserves lissity and reality for every coefficient embedding [def-wf-iota-real]. There are lifts $s,t$ of $x,y$ and positive integers $e,f$ such that $q_s=q_x^e$, $q_t=q_y^f$, and the characteristic polynomials of local Frobenius on $R(V)$ at $s,t$ equal those of $F_{V,x}^e,F_{V,y}^f$ [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. For every pair of summands $S_a,S_b$, there is a lift $t\prime$ of $y$ with $q_{t\prime}=q_t$ and an equivalence of Frobenius modules $(S_b)_t\simeq(S_a)_{t\prime}$. No eigenvalue or ambient subquotient diagram is specified.

Apply pointwise power transport first for R1 and then for R2. Multiply the positive residue degrees; the tower identity for cardinalities and invariance of characteristic polynomials of powers under Frobenius conjugacy give the required local identities. The pointwise transport property also proves reality for every coefficient embedding.

theorem exists_geometric_constituent_orbit
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsAffine X]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (V : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (hV : V.IsIrreducibleLisse)
    (x y : X.finitePoints)
    (hx : Nontrivial (V.stalk x).carrier) (hy : Nontrivial (V.stalk y).carrier) :
    ∃ (k₁ : Type u) (_ : Field k₁) (_ : Finite k₁) (_ : Algebra k₀ k₁)
      (_ : Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)) (d : ℕ) (C : Scheme.{u})
      (_ : C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))) (_ : IsAffine C)
      (_ : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : GeometricallyConnected (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : IsSeparated (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : LocallyOfFiniteType (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : QuasiCompact (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (R : WeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤ WeilSheaf k₁ l C)
      (_ : PreservesFiniteLimits R) (_ : PreservesFiniteColimits R)
      (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → WeilSheaf k₁ l C)
      (v : R.obj V ≅ ⨁ S) (c : C ⟶ X),
      0 < d ∧
      (∀ F : WeilSheaf k₀ l X, F.IsLisse → (R.obj F).IsLisse) ∧
      (∀ (F : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (ι : PadicAlgCl l →+* ℂ),
        F.IsReal ι → (R.obj F).IsReal ι) ∧
      (∀ a, (S a).IsGeometricallyIrreducible) ∧
      c ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) =
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁)) ∧
      ∃ (s t : C.finitePoints) (e f : ℕ), 0 < e ∧ 0 < f ∧
        c s.1 = x.1 ∧ c t.1 = y.1 ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard s.1 =
          (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).residueCard x.1 ^ e ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t.1 =
          (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).residueCard y.1 ^ f ∧
        ((R.obj V).stalk s).frobeniusEnd.charpoly =
          ((V.stalk x).frobeniusEnd ^ e).charpoly ∧
        ((R.obj V).stalk t).frobeniusEnd.charpoly =
          ((V.stalk y).frobeniusEnd ^ f).charpoly ∧
        ∀ a b : Fin n, ∃ t' : C.finitePoints,
          c t'.1 = y.1 ∧
          (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t'.1 =
            (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t.1 ∧
          Nonempty (((S b).stalk t).Equiv ((S a).stalk t'))
